meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: Claude 会执行 v1→v2 迁移的收尾:读取迁移状态文件,确认所有者并设定访问规则,迁移旧记忆,核对容器配置,评估自定义代码,最后运行验证并重启服务。
howto.when: 当用户说出‘migrate from v1’、‘finish migration’、‘v1 migration’等触发词,或表示要完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移,且迁移脚本已经运行过时,技能接管。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾吧。
say.note: Claude 会先读取迁移日志。

say.text: 迁移脚本跑完了,接下来怎么做?
say.note: Claude 会检查待办清单继续。

say.text: 我的 v1 有自定义改动,帮我处理。
say.note: Claude 会评估并处理 fork 代码。

howto.what_en: Claude finalizes v1→v2 migration: reads handoff file, confirms owner, sets access policy, migrates memory, checks container config, reviews custom code, runs verify, restarts service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'migrate from v1', 'finish migration', or 'v1 migration', after the migration script has completed.

say_en.text: Help me finish up the v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: Claude will read the handoff log first.

say_en.text: The migration script is done—what's next?
say_en.note: Claude will check the follow-up steps.

say_en.text: I have custom v1 code—please handle that.
say_en.note: Claude will assess and guide the fork handling.
